owner_question: Are important pages blocked by robots.txt or noindex?
evidence_to_collect: Public URL status plus robots and meta robots review
boundary: Readiness only; does not prove Google indexed the page

owner_question: Do canonicals and sitemap point to the buyer-facing URL?
evidence_to_collect: Canonical URL and sitemap inclusion screenshot or HTTP check
boundary: Readiness only; no ranking or click claim

owner_question: Can crawlers and buyers reach the page from public navigation?
evidence_to_collect: Home/resources/service link path and anchor text

owner_question: Does the page match pain phrases buyers search?
evidence_to_collect: Title/H1/meta/body language review against customer problem terms
boundary: Messaging evidence only; no demand proof

owner_question: Can a buyer see proof boundaries and next step?
evidence_to_collect: Proof policy contact pricing free-review and claim-boundary checks
boundary: Trust readiness only; no endorsement claim

owner_question: Is actual indexing and query data available?
evidence_to_collect: Search Console page indexing/impressions/clicks export from owner
boundary: Unavailable unless owner grants telemetry; never infer from readiness
